title: A remarkable start to Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2025: results and impressions from Stage I
body_html:
The first stage of the table tennis tournament held under the auspices of ATTP took place in a highly competitive atmosphere at TOP CUP Academy, confirming once again the rising level of the national Olympic movement.

The hall hosted close matches played with determination, technical discipline and deep respect for the principles of fair play, turning the whole competition into a true celebration of the sporting spirit ATTP promotes.

The tournament’s organisers and referees stood out for their professionalism and fairness, providing an impeccable playing environment and keeping every round running smoothly. The spectators actively backed the players, adding extra energy to the deciding duels and creating a motivating atmosphere for all participants.

Final standings of Stage I

Group A:

1st place - Arsenii IACUBENCO (Bălți)

2nd place - Nicolae TOMA (Chișinău)

3rd place - Ilie SULIMA (Chișinău)

Group B:

1st place - Damian PETRAȘCU (Bălți)

2nd place - Evgheni ZOTOV (Chișinău)

3rd place - Radomir CORGHENCEA (Chișinău)

Group C:

1st place - Vladimir PIȘCEANSCHI (Chișinău)

2nd place - Gheorghe RADU (Strășeni)

3rd place - Vasile ONȚA (Călărași)

Group D:

1st place - Gheorghe CUCOȘ (Glodeni)

2nd place - Veaceslav IAVORSCHI (Chișinău)

3rd place - Valerii BRICICO (Chișinău)

Group E:

1st place - Ruslan BORȘCI (Drochia)

2nd place - Alexandr DUPLII (Chișinău)

3rd place - Sergiu MUNTEANU (Chișinău)

This first stage confirms once again the unity and momentum of the ATTP community.

Passion for table tennis, professional organisation and a constant drive to improve are the foundation on which a modern, solid sporting movement is being built, day by day.
